from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    objs = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, color in enumerate(row):
            if color:
                objs.setdefault(color, []).append((r,c))
    ordered = sorted(objs, key=lambda color: min(c for r,c in objs[color]))
    origin_r = origin_c = 0
    prev_h = prev_w = 0
    for i, color in enumerate(ordered):
        cells = objs[color]
        min_r = min(r for r,c in cells); max_r = max(r for r,c in cells)
        min_c = min(c for r,c in cells); max_c = max(c for r,c in cells)
        if i:
            origin_r += prev_h - 1
            origin_c += prev_w - 1
        for r,c in cells:
            rr = origin_r + r - min_r; cc = origin_c + c - min_c
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
        prev_h = max_r - min_r + 1; prev_w = max_c - min_c + 1
    return out
'''
